how_to_edit: Stock for the trader you meet in dungeons (camp rooms and hidden merchant doors). It is rolled fresh for every floor of every run.
base_slots: always this many relics of base_slot_rarity (uncommon).
bonus_slots: extra slots that only sometimes appear, each with its own chance, holding a relic whose rarity is rolled from tier_weights (the same rates as chests).
prices: gold per rarity. Deliberately steep: gold-find relics (gold_bonus_percent) are how players afford the good slots.
Relics on offer follow the same rules as chests: usable by the adventurer's class, in the drop pool, and unlocked.

sell_consumables: false keeps potions and other consumables out of every shop: the dungeon trader, the tavern supplier and the Hearth's provisions. Buying potions makes a bad loop, so they have to be found.
potion_drops: true lets healing potions drop from enemies and appear in loot caches during runs, and lets potion relics into the drop pool.
